cohort: The study included 73 patients diagnosed with preterm pre-labour rupture of membranes (PPROM) presenting to a tertiary care hospital in Rawalpindi, Pakistan.
finding: Patients with PPROM and an amniotic fluid index less than five experienced significantly higher rates of maternal complications (Caesarean deliveries, chorio-amnionitis) and adverse neonatal outcomes (sepsis, respiratory distress syndrome, hypoglycemia, jaundice, hypothermia, and mortality).
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were significantly more common in patients with an amniotic fluid index less than five.
